title: Journal becomes a validated, indexed, replayable event log
summary: The journal module is split into five files and grows from a two-payload buffer into a versioned event model: ten event types, a typed actor (harness/person/system), cost, evidence grades, and a JSON Schema that every appended event is validated against before a byte is written. The buffer directory becomes `runs/`, a per-work-item index under `index/` records which runs belong to which work item under a file lock, and a new reader replays a run, checking each link of the hash chain and computing a second digest over decision fields only. The chain hash still proves the journal is intact; the replay digest is what two identical runs share.

nodes.label: Checkpoint runner
nodes.subtitle: osf verify --checkpoint
nodes.summary: Runs the checkpoint's moon tasks and writes one verification event per task plus one checkpoint-complete event. Now builds an `Actor::system("osf")` and fills the new `check_type`, `summary` and typed `EvidenceGrade` fields.

nodes.label: Review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run.rs
nodes.summary: Writes one review-answer event per judged lens and one review-decision event for the whole review, now through the typed actor.

nodes.label: Journal writer
nodes.subtitle: Journal::append / append_draft
nodes.summary: Opens `<state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl`, refuses an unsafe run id, validates the draft against the event schema, records the run in the work-item index on the first accepted event, and refuses any event after run-complete. A refused event writes no byte and leaves the chain head unchanged.

nodes.label: Event model
nodes.subtitle: event.rs
nodes.summary: The envelope (schema version, run, work item, change, actor, timestamp, cost, payload, prev_hash, hash) and ten payload types: run-started, verification, review, review-answer, review-decision, finding, state-change, run-complete, attention, checkpoint-complete.

nodes.label: Event schema
nodes.subtitle: event.schema.json
nodes.summary: Draft 2020-12 schema for one event, with per-event-type payload branches and cross-field rules: a harness actor must name a model, a blocked state change must carry a cause, a non-observed finding must not claim a verifier.

nodes.label: Schema validator
nodes.subtitle: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Compiles the schema once per process and returns one reason string per problem, each naming the JSON path. Called by the writer before every append and by the reader on every line.

nodes.label: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: hash.rs
nodes.summary: SHA-256 over prev_hash, a newline and the canonical JSON of payload, work item, change, actor and cost. Timestamp, run id and schema version are excluded. Adds the replay digest, which drops timings, cache outcomes, cost, run ids and transcripts.

nodes.label: Journal reader
nodes.subtitle: reader.rs
nodes.summary: Reads a run back, checking every line against the schema and every link against the recomputed hash. Any failure returns that line's error and no events, so a caller never sees a partial chain. Returns events, head hash, replay digest and whether the run completed.

nodes.label: Run index
nodes.subtitle: index.rs
nodes.summary: One JSON file per work item, named by the SHA-256 of the work item id, listing that item's run ids in recorded order. Writes go through a temporary file renamed over the target, under an advisory file lock held for up to ten seconds.

nodes.label: runs/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/runs/<run>.jsonl
nodes.summary: One hash-chained JSONL file per run. Replaces the old `buffer/` directory; the file format is unchanged, one event per line.

nodes.label: index/
nodes.subtitle: <state_dir>/index/<sha256>.json
nodes.summary: Per-work-item run lists, plus a `.lock` sibling per index file. Created only when a journal carries a work item.

nodes.label: checkpoint-evidence artifact
nodes.subtitle: ci.yml
nodes.summary: Uploads the state directory's journal files. The path changed from `buffer` to `runs` to follow the writer.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The checkpoint runner is the main producer: one verification event per task and one checkpoint-complete event per run.

edges.label: append(actor, payload)
edges.summary: The review run writes review-answer events and one review-decision event.

edges.label: validate(event)
edges.summary: Every draft is serialised and checked against the schema before the line is written; a failure returns the reasons and writes nothing.

edges.label: include_str!
edges.summary: The schema is embedded in the binary and compiled once per process.

edges.label: event_hash(HashInput)
edges.summary: The writer computes the next link from the previous hash and the draft's hashed parts.

edges.label: record_run(work_item, run)
edges.summary: The first accepted event of a run records the run in its work item's index before any journal line is written, so a failed index update refuses the event.

edges.label: one JSON line per event
edges.summary: Appends the serialised event as one line with a trailing newline.

edges.label: temp file + rename
edges.summary: Reads, appends and rewrites the work item's index under a lock, so a reader never sees a half-written file.

edges.label: read_to_string
edges.summary: Reads the run's JSONL file and checks it line by line.

edges.label: validate(line)
edges.summary: Each line is checked against the schema before it is parsed into an event.

edges.label: event_hash + ReplayDigest
edges.summary: Recomputes each link and accumulates the replay digest over the decision fields.

edges.label: same run-id rules
edges.summary: The reader and the index share the run-id validation that keeps a run id a safe single path component.

edges.label: upload-artifact
edges.summary: The evidence artifact now collects `runs/` instead of `buffer/`.
